content: ListenBrainz core /1/user/<user>/listens endpoint returns up to 1000 listens per GET (default 25), paginated via min_ts/max_ts, descending timestamp order. Official docs at listenbrainz.readthedocs.io. Suitable as a read-only listening-history enrichment source for a practice journal (e.g. correlate practice focus with recently-listened reference tracks).
